dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: Oh, because of somebody, I don't get enough sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: He's forcing me to spend too much time with him every night. It would be fine if we just go to the bar, but he just makes me to listen to gibberish by the side of the road.

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: If I liked hearing other people read, I'd go to a lecture!

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: Could it be that he's insinuating I should read more!?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: I didn't know that it's this tedious to date a bookworm!
